risk_if_not_implemented: Without Simulated Events, critical business processes and services may not withstand or recover from disruption, causing extended outages and data loss. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Loss of Critical Knowledge / Capability (R-PE-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9), Workforce Shortage / Loss of Critical Skills / Labor Disruption (MT-25).

compensating_control_1.name: Role-Based Security, Compliance & Resilience Training
compensating_control_1.description:
Mechanisms exist to provide role-based security, compliance and resilience-related training: 
(1) Before authorizing access to the system or performing assigned duties; 
(2) When required by system changes; and 
(3) Annually thereafter.
compensating_control_1.justification: Role-Based Security, Compliance & Resilience Training (SAT-05) provides personnel training and awareness that compensates for the absence of Simulated Events (BCD-09.1) by reducing human-factor risk by equipping personnel to recognize and respond to relevant threats. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Security, Compliance & Resilience Awareness Training
